description: Use when you need nearby RV stations from the dated FillPoint snapshot; see Data APIs. Nearest RV dump/water stations from FillPoint RV's dated September 17, 2026 ODbL snapshot. $0.01 for bounded straight-line proximity calculation, not live access, potable-water assurance or road routing. Snapshot age and unknown current conditions are explicit. Full underlying projection is free under ODbL. Price: 0.01 USDC. Minimal input example: {"latitude":42.07,"longitude":-88.36,"radius_km":50,"limit":10,"service":"dump"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"results":[],"distance_method":"great_circle_not_road_distance"}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): First use the existing shared allowance of 3 eligible calls per IP per UTC day, without payment metadata. This is shared with eligible HTTP trials, not a new allowance. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

latitude.description: Required. Latitude number in decimal degrees, -90 to 90. Example: 34.05.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum result count integer, 1–50. Example: 10. Defaults to 10.

longitude.description: Required. Longitude number in decimal degrees, -180 to 180. Example: -118.25.

radius_km.description: Optional. Search radius number in kilometres, 0.1–500. Example: 50. Defaults to 50 km.

service.description: Optional. Archived service filter enum string: dump, water or either. Example: water. Defaults to either.
